title: Coast Guard rescues one person from the water 1 mile south east of Pine Key Island
description: A Coast Guard Station St. Petersburg 45-foot Response Boat—Medium boat crew rescues a man from the water after his 16-foot catamaran capsized 1 mile south east of Pine Key Island Apr.10, 2021. The mariner was taken to Apollo Beach Marina without medical concerns. (U.S. Coast Guard photo)
credit: Petty Officer 3rd Class Erik Villa Rodriguez
pass_reason: Strong footage (man in churning water beside capsized catamaran grabbed by RB-M crew, 720p) but third capsized-boat pickup off Florida in a week: ccf-20261102-07 published Nov 4, ccf-20261104-01 held to Nov 8. Revisit after Nov 12; release thin, story about 25 s.
